working_units.title: Specify the formal model and required theorem statements
exit_criteria: Fix ordered endpoint pairs, qualifier/reference meanings and the independently stated graph invariant against the captured source slice.
Record semantic/reviewer ownership, the required general soundness statement and the conditions under which the slice has an inhabited valid graph.
Treat the existing companion schemas and APIs as draft projections to be aligned after formalization.

working_units.title: Formalize the typed model and validity predicates
exit_criteria: Typed identities, exact ordered signatures, qualifiers, references and the graph invariant have independent formal definitions.
The intended theorem quantifies over arbitrary finite supported inputs; all source-interpretation and external-evidence assumptions are explicit.

working_units.title: Define and exercise the formal reference checker
exit_criteria: The reference checker consumes the formal typed input directly and has no dependency on JSON decoding or host runtime integration.
Meaningful valid and invalid Lean examples exercise exact pairs, qualifiers, references and the selected graph invariant.

working_units.title: Prove soundness and close the formalization review
exit_criteria: Lean checks the exact general theorem with the pinned D00 toolchain and an audited dependency/axiom closure.
Check at least one inhabited valid formal graph so the selected use case is not vacuous.
Review accepts independent semantics and proof scope, including explicit source, parser, hash and compiled-runtime trust boundaries; this closes F0.

working_units.title: Recapture execution inputs and assess formal-model alignment
exit_criteria: Resolve every selected source and effective-state binding, retain candidate source posture and record implementation/reviewer assignments.
Compare the refreshed snapshot with the sources used by P01-P05; unchanged bindings permit adapter work, while relevant drift invalidates evidence and triggers replan/reproof.

working_units.title: Align candidate interfaces and implement the formal input adapter
exit_criteria: Document each schema/API field's mapping to the accepted formal types and meanings; the three-kind companion carrier retains the frozen v2 coverage boundary.
Reject malformed input and preserve identities, exact ordered pairs and qualifier shapes; state parser, hashing and host runtime assumptions explicitly.

working_units.title: Run the minimum working proof demonstration
exit_criteria: Receipt replay succeeds against the captured baseline.
Include an inhabited valid model and failing pair, qualifier, reference, digest and weakened-proof cases.
Demonstration reuses the proved Lean reference checker; any host projection is separately aligned and its trust boundary remains explicit.

working_units.title: Review and close L0
exit_criteria: Review all L0 predecessor evidence and unresolved assumptions.
Either accept the named slice or narrow it explicitly; do not call the full registry verified.

working_units.title: Implement snapshot resolution
exit_criteria: Every selected relation kind resolves to exact content and effective-state evidence.
Recompute measured coverage and retain provenance for all selected records.

working_units.title: Define complete carrier coverage
exit_criteria: Every selected kind has an explicit supported, unsupported or unresolved carrier classification.
Keep immutable schemas intact; test the excluded-kind rejection as a coverage mismatch.

working_units.title: Normalize the complete selected registry
exit_criteria: Every selected kind and exact ordered pair is imported with the captured identities and counts.
Projection controls reject omission, duplicates and a fabricated Cartesian-product pair.

working_units.title: Prove correspondence for registry-driven checking
exit_criteria: The generalized checker uses the accepted normalized registry.
The checked correspondence argument covers each imported signature; declaration coverage and semantic proof coverage remain distinct.

working_units.title: Implement typed reference resolution
exit_criteria: Check target versions, evidence types and role/scope constraints where the supported semantics require them.
Record every unresolved reference meaning as an explicit unsupported obligation.

working_units.title: Validate complete structural and scoped semantic coverage
exit_criteria: All selected records are accounted for and all supported checks are exercised.
Unsupported semantics remain visible; no declaration-level coverage is called complete semantic proof.

working_units.title: Implement deterministic replay and invalidation
exit_criteria: Repeated replay of identical inputs produces the same semantic result and identity.
Each relevant graph, registry, profile, rule, evidence or proof dependency change invalidates affected results.

working_units.title: Review and close L1
exit_criteria: All L1 tasks have accepted evidence and every unsupported semantic item is visible.
Authorize only the named baseline/profile for the following extension analysis.

working_units.title: Implement the proposal taxonomy and exact diff
exit_criteria: Classify every changed semantic field and exact source identity.
Separate selected-data compatibility, invariant preservation and model conservativity.

working_units.title: Implement complete obligation generation
exit_criteria: Each supported change profile generates its complete required obligations.
Submitted evidence may discharge obligations but cannot choose or shrink the required set.

working_units.title: Check selected-data compatibility
exit_criteria: Recheck the selected existing data against the proposed supported profile.
Record the exact data snapshot and scoped compatibility verdict; no generic preservation claim is made by this unit.

working_units.title: Prove generic invariant preservation
exit_criteria: Prove invariant preservation over arbitrary supported graphs under explicit extension assumptions.
Audit the statement and dependencies; sampled compatibility cannot discharge this theorem.

working_units.title: Verify models and the supported expansion theorem
exit_criteria: Chosen use cases have nonempty models with verified axioms.
A model-conservativity claim covers every base model with an expansion leaving the old reduct unchanged, for the supported profile.

working_units.title: Compose the extension impact report
exit_criteria: Show selected-data status, preservation status and conservativity status separately.
Rule-changing readiness remains pending until I06; unsupported obligations remain visible.

working_units.title: Review and close the supported L2 scope
exit_criteria: Accept scoped extension readiness only when every hard obligation for that scope is discharged.
Record the L3 handoff containing required rule obligations; G2 does not depend on their future discharge.

working_units.title: Specify supported inference and protected roots
exit_criteria: Define exact targetVersion, effect, scope and epoch matching for protected facts.
Rules introduce no fresh identities or external facts; independently justified existing admissions are allowed.

working_units.title: Implement derivation certificates and their checker
exit_criteria: Check rule identity, substitutions and every premise of each certificate step.
Reject fabricated roots, missing premises and unbound external facts.

working_units.title: Prove generic derivation soundness
exit_criteria: Prove generic certificate soundness against the independent inference semantics.
Audit the statement and assumptions; saturation completeness remains an I03 obligation.

working_units.title: Implement finite saturation and closure certificates
exit_criteria: Compute candidate saturation in the finite ground universe.
Reject missing rule consequences and invented members; negative theorem claims remain pending adequacy evidence.

working_units.title: Prove least-fixed-point adequacy
exit_criteria: Prove finite termination and that the checked closure is the least fixed point.
Establish the exact adequacy needed for supported non-derivability claims; timeout is not absence evidence.

working_units.title: Prove and exercise protected inference boundaries
exit_criteria: Check all protected identities including version, effect, scope and epoch.
Prove the boundary generically or use checked complete closure for explicitly bounded negative claims.

working_units.title: Validate the claimed independence witnesses
exit_criteria: A reported countermodel satisfies the theory and the negation of the specific implication.
Separate semantic non-entailment, profile non-derivability and failed bounded search.

working_units.title: Integrate the inference and evolution verdicts
exit_criteria: Each required rule soundness, closure, lineage and non-entailment obligation has correctly scoped evidence.
Recompute impact and invalidation for changed rules and theory dependencies.

working_units.title: Review and close L3
exit_criteria: All L3 predecessors have accepted evidence for the named inference profile.
Review exact negative-claim interpretations and the retained trust boundary.

working_units.title: Specify the review workflow contracts
exit_criteria: Each command has explicit input identities, supported profile and failure behavior.
No single success Boolean collapses execution, currentness and theorem evidence.

working_units.title: Implement isolated proof verification
exit_criteria: Audit theorem identity and full required statement against the obligation.
Control toolchain, imports and submission isolation; declare remaining parser/runtime trust.

working_units.title: Verify evidence identity and dependency closure
exit_criteria: Verify all bound source, graph, profile, rule, evidence and proof identities.
Reject substituted or stale dependencies and evidence labeled with the wrong method.

working_units.title: Implement complete readiness aggregation
exit_criteria: Derive the complete required obligation set independently and match scoped evidence to every member.
Omission or an unresolved mandatory obligation prevents readiness; the submission cannot weaken policy.

working_units.title: Implement and exercise CLI review
exit_criteria: Exercise valid proposals and representative semantic, proof and freshness failures.
Diagnostics identify the obligation, offending relation and next actionable step.

working_units.title: Implement and verify the candidate application adapter
exit_criteria: A changed baseline between review and simulated application forces fresh checking.
Keep the candidate recommendation distinct from human authority and actual admission.

working_units.title: Execute and review the shadow pilot
exit_criteria: Pilot covers supported positives, soundness/protected-boundary negatives, incompatible changes and workflow failures.
Human reviewers assess normative meaning and diagnostic usefulness separately from machine proof validity.

working_units.title: Review final evidence and supported-use recommendation
exit_criteria: Audit that each layer retained predecessor guarantees and closed its promised obligations.
State supported profiles, proof boundaries, owner decisions and remaining limitations; record a human use recommendation.
